description.value: Browns Social House is a casual full-service restaurant and bar chain with dozens of locations across BC and Alberta, operated by the Browns Restaurant Group. This Surrey Centre location offers a mix of food, drinks, and a social atmosphere, with weekend and holiday brunch service. It sits in a commercial plaza on King George Boulevard, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Surrey city centre corridor.

address.value: 9666 King George Boulevard, Surrey, BC V3T 2V4
